The structure of Ca8Mg2W2O16 (reduced formula Ca4MgWO8) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Ca and W centers coordinated by four O neighbors each, while Mg adopts a six-coordinate octahedral environment. Corner-sharing is observed between Ca and W tetrahedra, and between Ca tetrahedra and Mg octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
